C0370.title: GSM Hijacking and SMS Sniffing Used to Steal Verification Codes for Fraud
C0370.summary: Around 2018, users reported unauthorized transaction incidents involving GSM hijacking and SMS sniffing to steal SMS verification codes. Attackers used rogue base stations and sniffing devices to intercept bank and payment app verification codes while victims slept, then combined those codes with other account information or payment platform registration processes to conduct unauthorized transactions and online loan fraud. The method exploited weaknesses in 2G networks to capture SMS content in real time and could cause serious financial losses.

references.title: Henan High Court: How to Prevent Overnight SMS-Sniffing Account Theft
